premise: Little bubbles rise in the rock pool and Little Fish asks everyone who's making them, until he hears a giggle and finds Clam.
inspiration: The question-round of nursery tales (who killed… made safe: who's making the bubbles?), with the answer a giggle.

en-US.title: Bubbles in the Pool
en-US.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} [curious] Bloop. Bloop. Bloop. Little bubbles were rising in the rock pool. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish {fish:face surprised} swam round and round. Who's making bubbles? {urchin:enter} Was it Urchin? {urchin:live wiggle} Urchin wiggled his spines. Not me! Was it Seaweed? {seaweed:live sway} Seaweed swayed. Not me! {fish:face sad} [short pause] Then Little Fish heard a tiny giggle, right at the bottom. {clam:live peek} Clam opened up… and closed with a snap, and up came {clam:bubble-puff} a string of bubbles. {sfx:bubbles} Bloop, bloop! {fish:face happy} [laughs] It's you, Clam! {clam:face happy} {clam:live snap} Clam giggled again, and {clam:bubble-puff} more bubbles came up. {fish:live wiggle} Little Fish wiggled his fins and chased them. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] And soon everyone was laughing, and everything was full of bubbles. {clam:pulse}

es-ES.title: Burbujas en la charca
es-ES.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} [curious] Blup. Blup. Blup. Unas burbujitas subían por la charca. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito {fish:face surprised} nadaba en círculos. ¿Quién hace burbujas? {urchin:enter} ¿Sería Erizo? {urchin:live wiggle} Erizo meneó sus pinchos. ¡Yo no! ¿Sería Alga? {seaweed:live sway} Alga se meció. ¡Yo no! {fish:face sad} [short pause] Entonces Pececito oyó una risita, justo en el fondo. {clam:live peek} Almeja se abrió… y se cerró de golpecito, y subió {clam:bubble-puff} una ristra de burbujas. {sfx:bubbles} ¡Blup, blup! {fish:face happy} [laughs] ¡Eres tú, Almeja! {clam:face happy} {clam:live snap} Almeja se volvió a reír, y {clam:bubble-puff} subieron más burbujas. {fish:live wiggle} Pececito meneó las aletas y las persiguió. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] Y al poco, todos se reían, y todo estaba lleno de burbujas. {clam:pulse}

ja-JP.title: ぽこぽこ あわは だあれ？
ja-JP.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}[curious]ぽこっ。ぽこっ。ぽこっ。潮だまりに、小さなあわがのぼっていきます。{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんは、{fish:face surprised}ぐるぐるおよいで、「あわを出すのは、だあれ？」 {urchin:enter}ウニくんかな？{urchin:live wiggle}ウニくんは、とげをゆらゆら。「ぼくじゃないよ！」 海藻かな？{seaweed:live sway}海藻は、ゆーらゆら。「わたしじゃないよ！」 {fish:face sad}[short pause]そのとき、水のそこで、ちいさく、くすくす。{clam:live peek}貝さんがぱかっとひらいて…ぱちんととじると、{clam:bubble-puff}あわがつながって、のぼっていきました。{sfx:bubbles}ぽこぽこっ！{fish:face happy}[laughs]「貝さんだったんだ！」 {clam:face happy}{clam:live snap}貝さんがまたくすくすわらうと、{clam:bubble-puff}またまたあわがぽこぽこ。{fish:live wiggle}おさかなくんは、ひれをぴちぴちふって、あわをおいかけます。{urchin:face happy}{seaweed:face happy}{canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s}[happily]みんな、わらって、わらって、あたりはあわでいっぱい。{clam:pulse}

de-DE.title: Blubberblasen im Tümpel
de-DE.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} [curious] Blubb. Blubb. Blubb. Kleine Blasen stiegen im Tümpel auf. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Das Fischchen {fish:face surprised} schwamm im Kreis herum. „Wer macht denn hier Blasen?“ {urchin:enter} War es der Seeigel? {urchin:live wiggle} Der Seeigel wackelte mit seinen Stacheln. „Ich nicht!“ War es der Seetang? {seaweed:live sway} Der Seetang wiegte sich hin und her. „Ich nicht!“ {fish:face sad} [short pause] Da hörte das Fischchen ein winziges Kichern, ganz unten am Grund. {clam:live peek} Die Muschel ging auf… und klappte wieder zu, und herauf stieg {clam:bubble-puff} eine ganze Kette kleiner Blasen. {sfx:bubbles} Blubb, blubb! {fish:face happy} [laughs] „Du bist das, Muschel!“ {clam:face happy} {clam:live snap} Die Muschel kicherte wieder, und {clam:bubble-puff} noch mehr Blasen stiegen auf. {fish:live wiggle} Das Fischchen wedelte mit den Flossen und jagte ihnen hinterher. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] Und bald lachten alle, und überall waren Blasen. {clam:pulse}

fr-FR.title: Des bulles dans la mare
fr-FR.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} [curious] Bloup. Bloup. Bloup. De petites bulles montaient dans la mare. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Petit Poisson {fish:face surprised} tournait en rond. Qui fait toutes ces bulles ? {urchin:enter} C’était Oursin ? {urchin:live wiggle} Oursin a remué ses piquants. « Pas moi ! » C’était Algue ? {seaweed:live sway} Algue s’est balancée. « Pas moi ! » {fish:face sad} [short pause] Alors Petit Poisson a entendu un tout petit rire, tout au fond. {clam:live peek} Palourde s’est ouverte… puis refermée d’un coup, clac ! Et voilà que montait {clam:bubble-puff} un chapelet de bulles. {sfx:bubbles} Bloup, bloup ! {fish:face happy} [laughs] « C’est toi, Palourde ! » {clam:face happy} {clam:live snap} Palourde a ri de plus belle, et {clam:bubble-puff} d’autres bulles sont montées. {fish:live wiggle} Petit Poisson a frétillé des nageoires pour les attraper. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] Et bientôt, tout le monde riait, et il y avait des bulles partout. {clam:pulse}

it-IT.title: Bollicine nella pozza
it-IT.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} [curious] Blub. Blub. Blub. Tante bollicine salivano nella pozza. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pesciolino {fish:face surprised} nuotava in tondo, in tondo. «Chi fa le bollicine?» {urchin:enter} «Sei tu, Riccio?» {urchin:live wiggle} Riccio ha agitato gli aculei. «Io no!» «Sei tu, Alga?» {seaweed:live sway} Alga ha ondeggiato. «Io no!» {fish:face sad} [short pause] Poi Pesciolino ha sentito una risatina, proprio laggiù sul fondo. {clam:live peek} Vongola si è aperta… e si è richiusa di scatto, ed ecco salire {clam:bubble-puff} una fila di bollicine. {sfx:bubbles} Blub, blub! {fish:face happy} [laughs] «Sei tu, Vongola!» {clam:face happy} {clam:live snap} Vongola ha riso ancora, e {clam:bubble-puff} sono salite altre bollicine. {fish:live wiggle} Pesciolino ha mosso le pinne e le ha rincorse. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] E presto ridevano tutti, e c'erano bolle dappertutto. {clam:pulse}

zh-TW.title: 誰在吐泡泡？
zh-TW.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}[curious]啵。啵。啵。潮池裡冒出一顆一顆小泡泡。{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚{fish:face surprised}繞著圈圈游呀游：「是誰在吐泡泡？」 {urchin:enter}是海膽嗎？{urchin:live wiggle}海膽搖搖身上軟軟的刺。「不是我！」 是海草嗎？{seaweed:live sway}海草輕輕擺一擺。「不是我！」 {fish:face sad}[short pause]這時候，小魚聽見池底傳來小小的笑聲：嘻嘻。{clam:live peek}蛤蜊把殼打開……喀！又關起來，咕嚕咕嚕冒上來一串{clam:bubble-puff}泡泡。{sfx:bubbles}啵、啵！{fish:face happy}[laughs]「原來是你呀，蛤蜊！」 {clam:face happy}{clam:live snap}蛤蜊又咯咯笑了，{clam:bubble-puff}更多泡泡冒了上來。{fish:live wiggle}小魚擺擺鰭，追著泡泡游。{urchin:face happy}{seaweed:face happy}{canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s}[happily]不一會兒，大家都笑成一團，到處都是泡泡。{clam:pulse}

zh-HK.title: 石池裏的泡泡
zh-HK.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}[curious]啵。啵。啵。一顆顆小泡泡，從石池裏冒上來。{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚{fish:face surprised}游了一圈又一圈。「邊個吹泡泡呀？」 牠問{urchin:enter}海膽：「係咪你呀？」 {urchin:live wiggle}海膽搖搖身上的刺。「唔係我！」 牠問海草：「係咪你呀？」 {seaweed:live sway}海草輕輕擺一擺。「唔係我！」 {fish:face sad}[short pause]這時，池底傳來小小的一聲：嘻嘻。{clam:live peek}蜆張開殼……啪！又合上了，{clam:bubble-puff}一串泡泡冒了上來。{sfx:bubbles}啵、啵！{fish:face happy}[laughs]「原來係你呀，蜆！」 {clam:face happy}{clam:live snap}蜆又嘻嘻地笑，{clam:bubble-puff}泡泡又冒上來了。{fish:live wiggle}小魚擺動魚鰭，追着泡泡游。{urchin:face happy}{seaweed:face happy}{canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s}[happily]不一會兒，大家都笑起來，滿池都是泡泡。{clam:pulse}
